rounds.request: Evan, 05:37Z, on the paper figures: "It looks like the modeler just got lazy and did not try to model this charcter, but instead created an inspired character? I wanted THIS character, and the modeler got laze and didn't bother with hands. or  a real facial outline or nose"
rounds.notes: Parts first. Head: the pick's folded mask, a crown plateau, a forehead overhanging a recessed face panel with a nose ridge down its middle, cheek planes turned to the side, a jaw closing to a chin flap. Narrow neck column with two neck cords and a throat strip; the traps rise to it. Hands: palm, four three-joint fingers and a thumb, relaxed and curled toward the thigh, under a flared wrist cuff cut into flaps. Limbs carry a raised front keel and a slow twist so the folds run diagonally; the kneecap is a keeled band sitting in a V notch cut into the top of the shin shell; stronger pec planes; keeled deltoids.
rounds.proportions: Measured on the pick (crown 55, sole 1312 px): 7.3 heads. Knee centre ~947 px against the canon's ~956 (halfway between the front hip point ~600 and the sole): within 0.05 head, so the knee follows the pick. Elbow ~475 at the waist (~480) and wrist ~700 at the crotch (~705): on canon. Fingertips ~805 px against the canon's mid-thigh ~828: 0.13 head high, kept near the pick (which stops at ~800) rather than stretched.
